plan_notes.rotation: OVERRIDE for the 2026-10-15 unattended run: no rotation subset. The working set is ALL 4 science core + ALL 50 pool keywords, with no user seeds. Planned offline without WebSearch, using only keyword_pool, sources, news_data and cards_science. Every keyword is covered by at least one grouped query. Day-of-year 288 is even, so query phrasing flips back from 2026-10-14 (odd). Each expansion list leads with the even-day named models, labs and outlets: Isomorphic/Xaira/Chai over Insilico/Recursion/Generate; Aurora/GenCast/NeuralGCM over WeatherNext/AIFS/FourCastNet; Paradromics/Precision over Synchron/Neuralink; Rubin/SKA/Roman over Euclid/Gaia/LIGO; GNoME/A-Lab/Orbital over Periodic Labs/MatterSim/UMA; Chai-2/BindCraft over RFdiffusion/ProteinMPNN. Emphasis axes today (different from 10-14): protein design / genomics / single-cell, materials and battery discovery, LLM reasoning and theory of mind, brain-computer interfaces, exoplanets and cosmology, differentiable physics / neural operators, quantum chemistry. 10-14 leaned on mental health, weather, fusion, quantum computing, astronomy surveys and co-scientists.
plan_notes.source_strategy: Lead with outlet RSS / sitemap_news feeds and date archives, not WebSearch. WebSearch site: results skew evergreen. Harvest in this order: phys.org/archive/<dd-mm-yyyy>/ plus phys.org RSS (technology/machine-learning-ai, physics, space, chemistry, biology); techxplore.com machine-learning-ai RSS; sciencedaily.com/news/computers_math/artificial_intelligence/ and its releases RSS; arxiv API (export.arxiv.org/api/query, sortBy=submittedDate, categories cs.AI/cs.LG crossed with astro-ph, physics, q-bio, cond-mat.mtrl-sci, quant-ph; arXiv items only when an outlet or lab blog covers them, or when the lab is notable); eurekalert.org newsroom RSS; quantamagazine.org/feed; newscientist.com RSS (technology, space, physics); space.com, universetoday.com, livescience.com, thequantuminsider.com, physicsworld.com, genengnews.com feeds; deepmind.google/blog, research.google/blog, microsoft.com/research blog, allenai.org blog, news.mit.edu. Use the query list below only to fill gaps after the feeds.
plan_notes.window: 14 days: publish dates 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-15. Prefer the last 48-72h; older items only if no fresher candidate exists for that angle. Verify each published time on the article page (meta article:published_time / JSON-LD datePublished).

plan_notes.relevance_test: Keep only items where AI actually advances or intersects scientific research or method. Drop pure AI-industry noise (funding, compute, hiring). Clinical and patient-facing items (named disease, trial, FDA) belong to medicine; route them there and do not file under science.
plan_notes.safety_note: Avoid pathogen-enhancement / biosecurity stories entirely. Life-science picks are limited to protein structure, enzymes, therapeutics discovery, genomics and cell biology. Do NOT pick gain-of-function, virus/toxin design, AI-designed phage/viral genomes or bioweapon-adjacent stories; they halt the run. Swap the pick instead of rewording it.
plan_notes.recovery: Run the sequential recovery pass if fewer than 3 verified candidates.
